test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.

Mr Sharma would have left / the station / by this time / tomorrow.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Mr Sharma would have left**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence is the use of "**would have left**" when talking about a future event.
 
• For a future event, the correct phrase should be "**will have left**."
 
• The corrected segment should read "**Mr Sharma will have left**."

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 4**’

 

**Correct Sentence:** *Mr Sharma will have left the station by this time tomorrow.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **tomorrow**: This part of the sentence is correct. It refers to a future point in time.
 
• **by this time**: This part of the sentence is correct. It indicates a specific time in the future.
 
• **the station**: This part of the sentence is correct. It is the object of the verb.
